title: 2186. Minimum Number of Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram II

examples.explanation: - In 2 steps, we can append the letters in "as" onto s = "leetcode", forming s = "leetcodeas". - In 5 steps, we can append the letters in "leede" onto t = "coats", forming t = "coatsleede". "leetcodeas" and "coatsleede" are now anagrams of each other. We used a total of 2 + 5 = 7 steps. It can be shown that there is no way to make them anagrams of each other with less than 7 steps.
The given strings are already anagrams of each other. Thus, we do not need any further steps.
